pitfalls: Keep CS total distinct from CS/min. Current Academy source aliases CS with cs/min and defines CS per minute; the document generator overrides CS as a total count.
Do not define a Control Ward as revealing all stealth or as literally permanent; describe its ward/trap vision and disabling behavior narrowly, not as revealing every invisible champion.
ADC is a community role label for a bot-lane carry, not a champion class; marksman champions and the bot-carry role are related but non-identical categories.
glossary_factcheck.source_limit: Riot's stealth article is from the season-2017 update; use only for the conceptual distinction, not current item statistics or patch details.
